apis.name: ProduceRequest
apis.notes: Phase 07 Produce exactness complete. Advertised v0..=11 with full validation (acks, CRC, magic, timestamps, compression incl. Snappy, batch size limits, per-partition error isolation), wire suppression for acks=0, and version-matrix decode proof. Differential Java/librdkafka proof deferred to Phase 04/AUDIT-012. Idempotent/transactional semantics deferred to Phase 11/12.

apis.name: FetchRequest
apis.notes: Phase 06 storage contract slice plus Phase 08 Fetch hardening. Fetch still has no advertised versions or compatibility claim. Focused proof covers no extra long-poll sleep once min_bytes is satisfied, partition_max_bytes limiting, broker Fetch across dynostore/libsql/slatedb, leader-epoch fencing, dynostore FetchService ReadCommitted vs ReadUncommitted parity when no in-flight transactions (LSO==HWM), Fetch topic-id precedence over stale names, global max_bytes ceiling behavior across partitions, and Phase 04 differential librdkafka consume-after-produce (Fetch path) vs Kafka 4.2 when JANSU_DIFFERENTIAL=1. Remaining Phase 08 gaps include transactional read_committed / aborted-txn visibility, incremental sessions, and API 23 advertisement.

apis.name: ListOffsetsRequest
apis.notes: Phase 06 storage contract slice plus Phase 08 evidence: external differential ListOffsets v9 **latest** and **earliest** offsets after produce match Kafka 4.2 (see differential_lab test). Storage ListOffsets regression now asserts latest returns the current produced epoch while earliest returns the epoch active at offset 0 after multiple produced epochs. Routed API remains uncertified for advertisement until read_committed/LSO, truncation, and broader matrix proof land.

apis.name: OffsetCommitRequest
apis.notes: Phase 10 consumer group offset management. Postgres: `etc/initdb.d/010-schema.sql` includes `leader_epoch_history` and `consumer_offset.expires_at`; `011-offset-retention-patch.sql` upgrades older volumes; integration tests call `ensure_postgres_offset_schema` before connecting.
